objective_definition: Mean time from arrival to completion over the 17,000 jobs that follow the first 3,000 arrivals of a 20,000-job run. Each run continues until every job completes.

design.pairing: All policies receive the same arrivals, job attributes, and class profiles for each configuration and seed.
design.scope: Fresh seeds on the 81 development configurations. These are not tests on unseen configurations.

aggregation.seed_ratio: exp(mean over the configurations in a group of log(T_candidate / T_comparator)) for one seed
aggregation.change_pct: 100 * (mean of the eight seed ratios - 1); negative values favor the candidate
aggregation.ci95_pct: pointwise 95% Student-t interval over the eight seed ratios (7 degrees of freedom), in percent
aggregation.configuration_change_pct: 100 * (exp(mean over the eight seeds of log(T_candidate / T_comparator)) - 1)

policies.proposed: queue-aware optimistic backfilling with comparison factor 2 and gain threshold 1/8
policies.no_packing_repair: the proposed policy with the packing repair removed
policies.easy_wfp3: EASY backfilling with WFP3 priority, a published-method implementation
policies.forecast_easy_wfp3: locally constructed control: EASY-WFP3 order and running-job releases, with request*mean/(request+mean) as the calendar duration of waiting jobs

mean_response_layout: one row per configuration, in configuration order; one value per seed, in seed order
